'''Serinia''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of an unknown [[Ajah]].

==Activities==
When [[Jesamyn]] did not return from [[Caemlyn]], [[Elayne Trakand]] sent Serinia to discover what was wrong. She returned with Captain [[Charlz Guybon]] only to tell Elayne that Caemlyn had been overrun.{{ref/book|14|1}}

Having been sent to Caemlyn probably means that Serinia is strong enough to open a [[gateway]] alone to [[Travel]].

== Trivia ==
* Serinia is named for Shannan Lieb, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time'' whose username was Serinia.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
